description: Mediums, what a What can be passed over, and Mediations: the stack of Mediums a Connection is passed over, each optionally realized by a round trip of Transformations. Optional: a Connection with no Mediation leaves how it passes to the implementation. Extends Kernel, Contexts, Operations and Deployment.

axioms.about: A Medium's call is an Interaction of the Component that defines it
axioms.formula: all m in Medium. m.call.component == m.definer

axioms.about: A Medium's call is over the Medium's Language
axioms.formula: all m in Medium. m.call.language == m.language

axioms.about: A Component imports a Medium only from its siblings, or from what a Component it is nested in imports
axioms.formula: all c in Component, m in c.importedMediums. m.definer != c and (m.definer in c.parent.components or m.definer in c.system.components or m in c.^parent.importedMediums or m.definer in c.*parent.importedComponents)

axioms.about: A Mediation is over a Medium the deployed Component has access to
axioms.formula: all m in Mediation, k in m.connection.deployment.deployed. m.how.definer in k.*parent or m.how in k.importedMediums or m.how.definer in k.importedComponents

axioms.about: A realization goes down into the Medium's Language
axioms.formula: all m in Mediation, d in m.down. d.target == m.how.language

axioms.about: A realization comes up from the Medium's Language
axioms.formula: all m in Mediation, u in m.up. u.source == m.how.language

axioms.about: The first Mediation's realization goes down from its Connection's What
axioms.formula: all m in Mediation, d in m.down, c in m.firstOf, i in c.what. d.source == i.language

axioms.about: The first Mediation's realization comes up to its Connection's What
axioms.formula: all m in Mediation, u in m.up, c in m.firstOf, i in c.what. u.target == i.language

axioms.about: A further Mediation's realization goes down from the call of the Medium below it
axioms.formula: all m in Mediation, p in m.prev, d in m.down. d.source == p.how.language

axioms.about: A further Mediation's realization comes up to the call of the Medium below it
axioms.formula: all m in Mediation, p in m.prev, u in m.up. u.target == p.how.language

axioms.about: A realization is accessible to the Component a Connection goes from
axioms.formula: all m in Mediation, t in m.down, k in m.connection.from.of. t.holder in k.*parent or t in k.importedTransformations or t.holder in k.importedComponents

axioms.about: A realization's way up is accessible to the Component a Connection goes from
axioms.formula: all m in Mediation, t in m.up, k in m.connection.from.of. t.holder in k.*parent or t in k.importedTransformations or t.holder in k.importedComponents

axioms.about: A realization is accessible to the Instance a Connection goes to
axioms.formula: all m in Mediation, t in m.down, k in m.connection.toInstance.of. t.holder in k.*parent or t in k.importedTransformations or t.holder in k.importedComponents

axioms.about: A realization's way up is accessible to the Instance a Connection goes to
axioms.formula: all m in Mediation, t in m.up, k in m.connection.toInstance.of. t.holder in k.*parent or t in k.importedTransformations or t.holder in k.importedComponents

axioms.about: A realization is accessible to the Component a Connection goes to
axioms.formula: all m in Mediation, t in m.down, k in m.connection.toComponent. t.holder in k.*parent or t in k.importedTransformations or t.holder in k.importedComponents

axioms.about: A realization's way up is accessible to the Component a Connection goes to
axioms.formula: all m in Mediation, t in m.up, k in m.connection.toComponent. t.holder in k.*parent or t in k.importedTransformations or t.holder in k.importedComponents

axioms.about: Every Mediation of a Connection is on its first/next chain
axioms.formula: all c in Connection, m in c.mediations. m in c.first.*next

axioms.about: The first/next chain holds only the Connection's Mediations
axioms.formula: all c in Connection, m in c.first.*next. m in c.mediations

axioms.about: The Mediation chain has no cycles
axioms.formula: all m in Mediation. not m in m.^next
